classification.difficultyReason: Routine MST by Kruskal or Prim on small graphs of 5 and 6 vertices. The only extra decision is skipping one cycle-forming edge in part b.

content.prompt: Name the edges of the minimum spanning tree for each network.

answer.worked:
Choose edges in increasing weight order, omitting any edge that creates a cycle.
$$\begin{align*}DE&=2\\BC&=3\\AB&=4\\CD&=5\end{align*}$$
These four edges connect all five vertices without a cycle. The tree is $AB$, $BC$, $CD$ and $DE$.

Choose edges in increasing weight order, omitting any edge that creates a cycle.
$$\begin{align*}EF&=2\\BE&=3\\AD&=4\\BC&=5\end{align*}$$
The edge $CF=6$ would create a cycle, so omit it. The edge $AB=7$ joins $A$ and $D$ to the rest. These five edges connect all six vertices without a cycle. The tree is $AB$, $AD$, $BC$, $BE$ and $EF$.
